promptTemplate:
You are a separate new GPT-6.1 Sol adversarial reviewer of the SQL Server whole-table count guideline. READ ONLY: no writing, DB/Docker connections, measurements, delegation, workflows, commit or push. Read AGENTS.md SQL Server override and results/sqlserver/reviews/acceptance-criteria.json. Review docs/sqlserver-table-count-guideline.md and its links, sqlserver source and actual raw results, results/sqlserver/owner-proof.json. Verify all claimed hashes, actual status/exit/source/integrity/cleanup evidence and the support boundary ARM64/amd64 emulation. Owner summaries and author claims are not independent proof.
Act as adversarial validation/operations reviewer, first independently reviewing current guide/evidence BEFORE opening the first review results/sqlserver/reviews/final-engineer-result.json; then assess each first-review finding using evidence and include independentFindingAssessment array. Your priority is whether an unfamiliar engineer can obtain whole-table counts for huge service DBs without degradation, with explicit safe deferral where prerequisites cannot be met. Do not substitute engine encyclopedia or exhaustive grids. Challenge metadata visibility/partition/index doublecount, approximate vs exact vs stats-at-update, RLS count scope, bigint overflow, zero/NULL/permissions/errors not empty, ROWVERSION read assumptions vs default locking RC, Sch-S/DDL, tempdb/PVS/version retention, backup provisioning/resource isolation/shared readable secondaries/redo/freshness, commandtimeout vs locktimeout, query/session ownership/currentSPID/cancellation/serverend/recovery, live workload conservation/unfinished/censored/sparse windows, cache/index/order/TDE state, client key vs server keys and unmeasured AlwaysEncrypted. Check claimed max/min error and conditions by recomputing cited raw JSON; do not accept universal few%/10% guarantees or N-only safe primary scan thresholds. No oldMySQL nonlocking assumptions imported. NOLOCK/READPAST/whole-table-lock or deliberate contention injection not allowed. Do not request excluded dangerous experiments. Counts must be RCSI or SNAPSHOT qualified; no automatic production isolationconfiguration change. Existing inventory/approvedexport first, no primaryextraSQL withoutbudget, resourcecaps before monitoring, no viablepath=>defer. Compare simpler/faster viable alternatives forrequiredprecision andfreshness, no unsupported globalranking. 100M/80/100col/encryption actual measurement vs missing combinations must be distinguishable, nativeproductionperformance not inferred fromemulation.
Raise only actual operational material defects with concrete scenario/source/evidence/correction, not stylistic preferences. High/middle and necessary measurement gaps block acceptance. Do not demand every possible experiment if safe explicitly limited guidance resolves the decision. Accept only exact current guide and linked details/proof/source verified, no blocking defect/necessary experiment pending. Preserve failures/unknowns, never mark skipped coveragepassed. Return SMALL JSON: accepted boolean, decision accepted/rejected, role, guidelineSha256, proofSha256, findings array(id,severity,scenario,evidence,requiredCorrection), requestedExperiments array(onlyindispensable,whydecisiondepends), reviewQuestions object(betterMethods,designCoverage,omissions,lockFactors,fastCount), reviewEvidence array concrete files/fields/hash/recomputation. Do not assert otherrole acceptance without artifact.

Read results/sqlserver/reviews/owner-open-findings.json and independently verify the actual corrections to every owner material finding; disposition labels alone are not proof.
